---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose an architecture addition or new capability
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature solves. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

Describe the ideal solution you want. How should this behave deterministically?

## Business Value & Workflow Impact

How does this improve the FlowGuard ecosystem? Which specific automation workflows does this enhance?

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered. Why is your proposed solution better?

## Architecture & Scalability Considerations

* How does this affect our Service-Layer Architecture?
* Are there database schema changes required?
* How does this scale under heavy load?

## Security Considerations

Does this feature expose new data, require new authentication scopes, or introduce potential attack vectors?

## UI/UX Expectations

If applicable, describe the intended futuristic glassmorphism UI interaction, or attach mockups/wireframes.
